image_description: A Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja) perched on a tree branch. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on its body and wings, with a prominent red patch on the shoulder/upper wing area. It has a long, flat, spatulate bill that is greyish-pink in color. The neck is retracted in an S-curve posture typical of resting spoonbills. The legs are long, thin, and dark pink/grey, gripping a textured branch. The background is a soft-focus green foliage.
